posts.title: I just wanted to play. Now I’m changing the games.
posts.description: Three game projects with Claude Opus 5.5 changed how I see existing software. The current wave of game mashups, native ports, and application clones explains why.

posts.title: “This AI model is good.” By whose standards?
posts.description: Why the same AI model can be useful to one person and unacceptable to another. Research, user reports, and a practical way to test your own quality threshold.

posts.title: Knowledge, reasoning, and style: Can AI keep them separate?
posts.description: Why an AI assistant can know the facts and still miss local rules. Research on separating knowledge, reasoning, and style, explained through concrete examples and a testable design for more adaptable assistants.
